text: Repeated measures (from Time 1 to Time 3) analysis of variance with cognitive and psychological outcomes as dependent variables
Footnote: For each variable, time was the random factor and group assignment the fixed factor. Immediate and delayed memory were measured with the Hopkins Verbal Learning Test,
with the Controlled Oral Word Association Test,
attention and executive functioning with Trail Making Tests Part A and B.
Perceived cognitive impairment and quality of life were measured with
the Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy-Cognitive Function Instrument version 3 (FACT-Cog), Perceived Cognitive Impairments (PCI) and the FACT-Cog Quality of Life (QOL) subscales.
Short Form 8a scales were used to measure anxiety, feelings of depression, and fatigue. Stress was measured using the Perceived Stress
The PROMIS Pain Interference-Short Form 6 assessed pain intensity.
The Levene’s Test of homogeneity was not violated for any of the models.
J Psychosom Res. Author manuscript; available in PMC 2022 November 01.
